items.kw: Can He Really Play a Cardboard Melodica? 🎹😂#lamineyamal #football #vinicius
items.desc: Vini Jr. took one look at his cardboard melodica and decided Yamal's shiny red one was a much better choice. So he swapped them! 😂 But somehow Yamal managed to play a lovely little tune on the cardboard one, while Vini couldn't get a single musical note out of the real instrument. 🎶 Olise was watching over Vini's shoulder, Raphinha was right behind Yamal, and neither could keep a straight face. What started as a little music session on a sunny tropical football terrace ended with everyone laughing at Vini's musical performance! 🌴🤣 Which melodica would you have chosen? 🎹
